title: Discussion Text
summary: Discussion text: struktur issue–arguments for–arguments against–conclusion, penanda kontras, mengklasifikasi argumen pro dan kontra, menentukan posisi penulis, serta membaca simpulan yang seimbang.

blocks.html:
Discussion text menyajikan sebuah isu dari dua sisi atau lebih (pendukung dan penentang) sebelum memberi simpulan atau rekomendasi. Teks ini membantu pembaca melihat persoalan secara utuh.

BagianIsi
Issueisu yang diperdebatkan, sering dalam bentuk pertanyaan
Arguments forargumen pendukung beserta buktinya
Arguments againstargumen penentang beserta buktinya
Conclusion / recommendationsimpulan seimbang, jalan tengah, atau pendapat penulis setelah menimbang

blocks.title: Ciri kebahasaan
blocks.html:
• Penanda kontras: however, on the other hand, whereas, while, in contrast.
  • Penanda pihak: supporters argue, opponents believe, critics point out, advocates emphasize.
  • Penanda simpulan: on balance, ultimately, in conclusion, all things considered.
  • Bahasa berimbang: may, might, could.

blocks.title: Discussion vs exposition
blocks.html: Exposition memihak satu sisi sejak awal. Discussion memberi ruang yang adil kepada kedua sisi, dan simpulannya sering bersyarat (may be wise for ..., but only if ...).

blocks.question: Which phrase usually introduces the opposing side in a discussion text?
blocks.explanation: On the other hand memperkenalkan sudut pandang yang berlawanan.

blocks.html:
A Four-Day School Week?

[Issue] A few schools in some countries have experimented with a four-day school week, with longer lessons on the remaining days. Some people believe this model could benefit students and teachers, while others think it could harm learning.

[Arguments for] Supporters argue that an extra free day gives students time to rest, pursue hobbies, or help their families, which may reduce stress and absence. Teachers could use the day for training and lesson planning. Schools also save money on transport, electricity, and cleaning.

[Arguments against] Opponents, however, worry that longer school days tire students, especially younger ones, and that concentration falls in the final hours. Working parents may struggle to find childcare on the extra free day. Some studies in districts that adopted the model also found small drops in test scores over time.

[Conclusion] On balance, a four-day week may suit some communities but not others. Before any change, schools should consult parents and teachers and monitor student achievement carefully.

blocks.title: Soal klasifikasi
blocks.question: Classify: (1) savings on electricity; (2) difficulties with childcare; (3) more time for teacher training.

blocks.title: Soal simpulan
blocks.question: What is the writer's conclusion?
steps: Penulis tidak memihak penuh: cocok untuk sebagian komunitas, dengan syarat konsultasi dan pemantauan.
blocks.answer: The model may suit some communities, but it requires consultation and monitoring

blocks.question: Which evidence is used by opponents?

options.B: Some studies found small drops in test scores.
options.C: Students have time to pursue hobbies.
options.D: Teachers can plan lessons on the free day.

blocks.explanation: Some studies ... found small drops in test scores ada di paragraf 3 (opponents).

lessons.title: Latihan interaktif: pro, kontra, dan posisi penulis

blocks.title: Argumen pro dan kontra serta posisi penulis
blocks.caption: Kelompokkan argumen tentang kamera pengenal wajah, lalu tentukan posisi penulis dari kalimat simpulannya.

blocks.title: Strategi mengerjakan
blocks.html:
• Beri tanda + dan − di samping paragraf atau kalimat yang mendukung dan menentang.
  • Untuk soal On which point do both sides agree?, cari kalimat di simpulan seperti Both sides agree ...
  • Soal situasi (Which situation would be difficult for ...?) dijawab dari contoh konkret di teks.
  • Posisi penulis ada di simpulan, bukan di paragraf pro atau kontra.

blocks.title: Jebakan yang sering muncul
blocks.html:
• Menganggap argumen salah satu pihak sebagai pendapat penulis.
  • Mengira simpulan seimbang berarti penulis tidak punya pendapat sama sekali.
  • Tertukar argumen pro dan kontra karena keduanya memakai kata argue.
Setelah memahami materi dan contoh di atas, kerjakan kuis bab ini. Teks Tingkat Lanjut lebih panjang dan argumentatif, jadi bacalah dengan teliti dan pelajari pembahasan setiap soal yang salah.
